title: sakina hui aaj paida mubarak
body:
sakina hui aaj paida mubarak
hai dil qush shahe karbala ka mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
hui saanie fatima aaj paida
bohot shaad hai roohe zahra mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
rabaab aur shabbir ki ye jaha'n me
hui duqtare maahe paarah mubarak
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina ki taqdeer se chalan se
sadaqat ka izhaar hoga mubaarak
<<DIVIDER>>
hai abbas jis shaahzaadi pe qurbaa'n
hui sheh ko beti wo paida mubarak
